correctness.rationale: The proof checks the exact deletion/intersection equivalence, proves that heavy-coordinate sets of distinct codewords are disjoint, uses pigeonhole to force a heavy coordinate for every \(n\ge7\) composition, classifies all heavy-free compositions at \(n=5\) and \(n=6\), and supplies matching witnesses. The finite verifier independently exhausts the two exceptional lengths; the infinite conclusion does not rely on finite enumeration.

value.rationale: The claim gives a natural complete exact classification for the ternary version of the recent extremal regime in which the output has size three. It replaces a general upper bound of six by the exact sequence \(4,4,3,3,\ldots\) and an all-\(n\) structural proof. The result identifies a sharp threshold at \(n=7\) and is not a renaming, routine recomputation, or arbitrary finite slice.
